changelog:
────────────────
✨ New Features
────────────────
• Hidden a new type of community post
• Custom branding: Add experimental YouTube launcher icons
• Theme: Add experimental YT splash screen animation
• Validate custom header and icon folders when the option is set
• Redirect Watch later saves to a chosen playlist
• Downloads: Add download item to the Shorts menu
• Add Niconico-style live/replay comments
• Downloads: Add playlist downloads for accounts without Premium
• Channel search: Search the posts of the channel
────────────────
🌟 Mod Features
────────────────
• All Morphe patches for YouTube
• Google and Yandex voice-over translation (VoT)
• Video downloader with Save to device
• Customizable preset settings for a Premium-like experience
• Extra clone variant with Dynamic Island on supported devices
• In-app update check for new builds
────────────────
🐛 Bug Fixes
────────────────
• Feed video actions: Watch later button is missing after scrolling up
• Remove legacy litho buffer filtering code required for app versions less than 20.22, change legacy support to 20.26.46
• Channel page community posts do not load when feed "Hide community posts" is enabled
• Feed view count: View count badge covers the duration in right to left languages
• Feed video actions: Watch later button opens the channel in right to left languages
• Watch page feed lags when scrolling
• Feed thumbnail badges are missing after scrolling up, show a loading spinner until they are loaded
• Downloads: Downloaded videos that work at first may not work later
• Yandex VoT: Crash when long-pressing the button to open its settings
